title: Sparkly backpack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles around the backpack -->
  <g fill='#FFE45E'>
    <!-- top left sparkle -->
    <path d='M18 12 L20 18 L26 20 L20 22 L18 28 L16 22 L10 20 L16 18 Z'/>
    <!-- top right sparkle -->
    <path d='M82 10 L84 15 L89 17 L84 19 L82 24 L80 19 L75 17 L80 15 Z'/>
    <!-- bottom left sparkle -->
    <path d='M14 72 L16 77 L21 79 L16 81 L14 86 L12 81 L7 79 L12 77 Z'/>
    <!-- bottom right sparkle -->
    <path d='M86 70 L88 75 L93 77 L88 79 L86 84 L84 79 L79 77 L84 75 Z'/>
    <!-- small sparkles -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='8' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='7' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='8' cy='50' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='48' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='25' cy='92' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='75' cy='94' r='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Backpack main body -->
  <rect x='25' y='30' width='50' height='55' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- Backpack body shading/detail -->
  <rect x='25' y='30' width='50' height='55' rx='12' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#FF8F8F' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Top flap -->
  <path d='M25 42 Q25 24 50 24 Q75 24 75 42 L75 48 Q75 50 73 50 L27 50 Q25 50 25 48 Z' fill='#FF4757'/>
  <path d='M27 46 Q27 30 50 30 Q73 30 73 46' fill='none' stroke='#FF6B81' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Flap buckle/button -->
  <rect x='46' y='42' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <rect x='47' y='43' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#FFB800'/>

  <!-- Front pocket -->
  <rect x='33' y='58' width='34' height='20' rx='6' fill='#FF8F8F'/>
  <rect x='33' y='58' width='34' height='20' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#FFAAAA' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Pocket zipper line -->
  <line x1='36' y1='63' x2='64' y2='63' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Pocket zipper pull -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='63' r='2.5' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='63' r='1.2' fill='#FFB800'/>

  <!-- Straps coming from top -->
  <path d='M35 30 Q32 20 36 16 Q40 12 42 16 Q44 20 42 30' fill='#FF4757'/>
  <path d='M65 30 Q68 20 64 16 Q60 12 58 16 Q56 20 58 30' fill='#FF4757'/>

  <!-- Handle on top -->
  <path d='M44 24 Q50 16 56 24' fill='none' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Small side pocket detail left -->
  <rect x='25' y='60' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#FF8F8F'/>
  <!-- Small side pocket detail right -->
  <rect x='71' y='60' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#FF8F8F'/>
</svg>
